name: warm_admiration
description: Friend shares a creative win / achievement / good news. Agent responds with warmth and present-celebration. Events are user_greeting + user_question only — `user_praise` is intentionally avoided here because its reward_signal=0.8 in the appraisal layer drives joy→assertiveness up, producing a *bold/declarative* register (V=+0.39, D=+0.63) that reviewers read as boastful rather than warm-celebratory. user_greeting (social_safety=0.5) + user_question (novelty=0.4) lift warmth and curiosity without spiking joy, yielding a more responsive register suitable for `look at the painting I just finished`-type prompts.
